points.label: Transformation, grief, and gathering
points.left: Denied resurrection is answered by an ordered future. Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead? When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
points.right: Grief is answered with resurrection and gathering. But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, about those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. Therefore comfort one another with these words.
